title: Probe case
description: Declarative probe against the pinned vercel/serve reference. Each probe spawns a fresh serve instance against an inline fixture and runs an ordered list of HTTP requests.

id.description: Probe id. Optional; defaults to the file name without extension.

description.description: Free-form prose displayed in the result report.

files.description: Map of fixture-relative path to file content. Strings are written as utf-8; objects with a base64 field are written as binary.

serveJson.description: Optional serve.json contents. Written verbatim into <fixture>/serve.json before the server starts.

serveArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to `node third_party/serve/build/main.js` after the runner's own --listen / --no-clipboard / --no-port-switching.

name.description: Stable identifier of this request within the probe (used as a section heading in the report).

path.description: Request path. Must include the leading slash. Use percent-encoded characters as-is.

redirect.description: How fetch handles redirects. Default 'manual' (so the runner records the 301/302 itself rather than chasing it).
